`legacy-pixabay-pop.mp3` is an unchanged copy of the former bundled
`skill/kinotta/assets/sfx/pop.mp3`, retained only to test old project audio.
It is not part of the synthesized catalogue.

The original credits identify Pixabay as its source and the
[Pixabay Content License](https://pixabay.com/service/license-summary/) as its terms.
The repository's source notice records upstream
`heygen-com/hyperframes` revision `b211fc7cb845c6838cbdb1860506c2fda2804787`,
path `skills/media-use/audio/assets/sfx/`.
